messages.author: 445326394b5cd0f9
messages.subject: How to un-rasterize lines?
parts:
I must be missing something obvious, either in the ggplot2 book or in
the discussions on this forum. When I create a plot with geom_line the
resulting lines are rasterized stair-step looking things. No journal I
know of would be willing to publish these. I can't figure out how to
make them look smooth. I thought perhaps it is a matter of the
graphics options in R rather than something I can specify in ggplot2,
but when I set windows.options ( xpinch=1200, ypinch=1200 ) I still
get stair-steps. And exporting as bmp or jpg doesn't help.

So -- does anyone know how I can get smooth straight lines?

--

messages.subject: Re: How to un-rasterize lines?
parts:
Save as a pdf or other vector graphics format:

ggsave(my_plot,file='my_plot_file.pdf')
